errors.text_span: Диаграмата включва общо 22 сектори, представляващи отделните отговори.
errors.evidence: The chart has 6 sectors representing 6 categories of answers, not 22 sectors. 22 is the total number of responses.

errors.text_span: Най-големият сектор е син и представя приблизително 36,4% от отговорите и обозначава “Под 1 година”.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The blue sector ("Под 1 година") is one of the smallest and is not labeled with a percentage. The largest sectors are the red and orange ones, both at 36.4%.

errors.text_span: жълт сектор, съставляващ 36,4% от отговорите и е маркиран като “От 1 до 5 години”.
errors.evidence: The orange/yellow sector is indeed 36.4%, but it corresponds to the category “От 6 до 15 години”, not “От 1 до 5 години”. The category “От 1 до 5 години” is represented by the red sector.

errors.text_span: Зелен сектор с приблизително 13,6% от отговорите е обозначен като “От 6 до 15 години”.
errors.evidence: The green sector is 13.6%, but it corresponds to the category “От 16 до 30 години”, not “От 6 до 15 години”.
The chart does not provide a percentage value for the purple sector. The value '4%' is hallucinated.
The chart does not provide a percentage value for the light blue sector. The value '2%' is hallucinated.
The description completely omits any mention of the red sector, which represents the category 'От 1 до 5 години' and accounts for 36.4% of the responses, making it one of the two largest segments.

errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат подредени по намаляващ размер.
errors.evidence: This is not accurate, as two sectors are tied for the largest size (36.4% each). The arrangement is not strictly in descending order of size.
